name: Gujarat Toolroom Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1991, Gujarat ToolRoom Ltd
is engaged in different trading businesses.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
GTRL is engaged in a diversified trading 
business, dealing in a wide range of products
 including Silver Conductive Ink, Construction Materials, Fabrics, Agriculture Commodities, 
and trading of Equity Shares.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.35 times its book value
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 375 days to 129 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has high debtors of 217 days.
